{{Quote|Trapper, Ponds, Hawkeye, come with me!|Mace Windu|<ref name="TZB" />}}
'''Hawkeye''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who fought for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during a [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|battle]] with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the battle, Hawkeye was part of a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission sent to find several other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who had vanished into a massive [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] created by an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] used against the Separatists. Upon locating the troopers, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] selected Hawkeye, another trooper named [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]], and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]] to further investigate the sinkhole. Hawkeye and party, in their search, unknowingly climbed upon a dormant [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], an ancient creature of titanic size thought to be extinct. The sight of the awakened beast prompted the scouting party to flee the sinkhole, with the exception of Hawkeye, whom the Zillo Beast trampled to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TZB" />

==Biography==
Hawkeye was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="TZB" /> of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> and was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="TZB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TZB" /> he was serving as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] had a large [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] supply that both the Separatists and the Republic wanted for themselves, which sparked a [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|battle]] on the planet. The Republic sent a taskforce that inlcuded clone troopers, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a heavy infantry to stop an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in order to keep the fuel supplies secure, with Hawkeye being a part of the Republic group. The Republic also launched a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which was capable of deactivating mechanical objects like [[Repulsorlift/Legends|speeders]], [[Computer/Legends|computers]], and droids, but had no effect on organics. The [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] worked and all the droids present were deactivated. However, as a side effect, a huge sinkhole was created in the center of the [[Droid Army]]. In addition to the Separatist forces, the sinkhole also trapped some clone troopers from the Republic front line who fell into it.<ref name="TZB" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] formed a small group to [[Scout/Legends|investigate]] including Hawkeye, [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]], [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], and some other clone troopers to form the search team that went down into the sinkhole. When they managed to find some of the lost clones, the search group learned from them that something else was down in the sinkhole with them. General Windu then led Hawkeye and the other searchers to investigate the area further. In their search, he and the rest of the squad found themselves on a hard surface, which they discovered was actually the back of a giant and ancient [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as a [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]. The clones tried to shoot at the beast, but its hide was too thick for their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to penetrate, leaving them no choice but to flee from it. While the rest of the team barely escaped to a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunship]] with the help of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Hawkeye fell behind and was crushed by the feet of the beast as it chased the rest of the group.<ref name="Death">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-8|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #8|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}} established that the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] occurred after the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]]. "[[The Zillo Beast]]" occurred during the Battle of Malastare and depicted a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] being crushed by the Zillo Beast, with the two possible clones with the same appearance being [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]] and Hawkeye. As Trapper appeared in "[[Landing at Point Rain]]," which was set during the Second Battle of Geonosis, he must have survived the Battle of Malastare, meaning that Hawkeye must have been the clone trooper that was [[Death/Legends|killed]].</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="Episode II" /> Hawkeye was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Hawkeye wore<ref name="TZB" /> [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="NEGTWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and wielded<ref name="TZB" /> a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] like many other clone troopers.<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hawkeye first appeared in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series that aired on [[April 3]], [[2010]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced all of the other clone troopers on the show.<ref name="TZB" /> When originally released, it was not revealed whether the clone trooper who died was Hawkeye or Trapper, as both wore the same armor. Trapper later appeared in "[[Landing at Point Rain]]," which was confirmed to take place after "The Zillo Beast" by the eighth part of the [[Chronicling The Clone Wars|Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'']] blog series. Therefore, Hawkeye was the clone trooper who died in "The Zillo Beast."<ref name="Death" /> Hawkeye and Trapper's names are a nod to the characters [[Wikipedia:Hawkeye Pierce|"Hawkeye" Pierce]] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_M*A*S*H_characters#Trapper_John Trapper John], from the television sitcom [[Wikipedia:M*A*S*H|M*A*S*H]], which aired in the 1970s through early 80s.<ref name="MASH">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-answers-mash-troopers|text=The Clone Wars Answers: MASH Troopers?}}</ref>
